meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计并运行量子电路，模拟噪声效应
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Google 量子硬件上设计噪声感知电路
copy.tagline_en: Design and run quantum circuits, simulate noise effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design noise-aware circuits for Google quantum hardware

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Python 编写量子电路,进行模拟、参数扫描、噪声建模和优化,并支持提交到 Google、IonQ 等量子硬件上运行。
howto.when: 当你说要设计或模拟量子电路、针对 Google 等量子硬件运行任务,或者做噪声建模、参数扫描等量子实验时触发。

say.text: 用 Cirq 构建一个两比特量子电路并模拟运行
say.note: Claude 会生成 Cirq 代码并给出模拟结果

say.text: 给这个电路加上退极化噪声,对比不同噪声率
say.note: Claude 会做噪声模拟并分析输出

say.text: 把电路提交到 IonQ 的 QPU 上跑
say.note: 需要你提供 API Key 等认证信息

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use the Cirq framework to build, simulate, and run quantum circuits in Python, including parameter sweeps, noise modeling, circuit optimization, and submission to quantum hardware such as Google and IonQ.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to design or simulate quantum circuits, target Google or other quantum hardware, or perform noise modeling and quantum characterization experiments.

say_en.text: Build a two-qubit quantum circuit with Cirq and simulate it.
say_en.note: Claude will generate Cirq code and show simulation results.

say_en.text: Add depolarizing noise to this circuit and compare different noise rates.
say_en.note: Claude will run noisy simulations and analyze outputs.

say_en.text: Submit this circuit to IonQ's QPU for execution.
say_en.note: You may need to provide API keys for authentication.
